description: This PHP class represents a data transfer object (DTO) for theme images within the OrangeHRM corporate branding plugin. It encapsulates properties like file content, filename, file type, and size, along with methods for accessing and converting this data.

classes.name: ThemeImage
classes.description: DTO for encapsulating theme image data, including content, filename, file type, and file size.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize ThemeImage with content, filename, type, and size.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the image content as a string, reading from resource if necessary.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the image.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the image file.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if all properties (content, filename, type, size) are null.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the object to an associative array.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a ThemeImage instance from an array.
